purpose: Quantify image-sampling uncertainty for the conditional KaryoFlow+LQCR minus DINO mAP difference.
estimand: Difference in COCO bbox mAP over the 1000-image held-out cohort, conditional on the evaluated checkpoints and inference protocols.

resampling.pairing: the same resampled image multiplicities are used for both detectors
resampling.metric_recomputation: rerun global stable score ordering and COCO AP accumulation for every replicate

ours.replication_semantics: mean prediction performance over three independently trained detector checkpoints, each evaluated at inference seed 42

baseline.replication_semantics: mean prediction performance over inference seeds 42, 123, and 789 for one fixed trained checkpoint; not a training-seed mean

allowed_claim: The evaluated checkpoints are statistically comparable under conditional image-sampling uncertainty.
forbidden_claims: KaryoFlow+LQCR is superior to DINO on Dataset 2
the bootstrap substitutes for independent training replication
